info.description: A named room or space on the campus tour, with its photographs. Mirrors the `facilities` export of apps/web/src/data/campusTour.ts. `pending` marks one the school has named but not photographed — the tour shows it as awaited rather than inventing a picture.

alt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.
